Name: New NPC Carnelian 1.6
Author: muxuelaiyin
Description:
你好，这里是卡尼里安的非官方1.6更新，已获得原作者授权。
一直生活在恶劣环境的恶魔，在魔界斗争失败逃亡到了星露谷的森林，无处可归的他决定暂住这个未知的美丽地方。
如果新来的农场主愿意接近他，或许他会永久地居住下来？ 
居住地：森林玛尼家下面大葱地
最爱：五彩碎片 红宝石 精灵珠宝 骨笛 苹果 罂粟籽松糕 虚空精华 
喜欢 ：蝙蝠翅膀 食物类 花卉 戒指 宝石 矿物 
不喜欢：动物产品 肥料
厌恶：垃圾 鱼饲料 资源 茄子
事件触发：
0❤：游戏时间7天后，6点到14点，进入森林触发。
2❤：晴天，【已有宠物】，6点到16点，进入森林触发。
4❤：晴天，20点到23点，进入海滩触发。
6❤：晴天，8点到18点，进入秘密森林触发。 
8❤：晴天，8点到18点，进入小镇触发。 
10❤：晴天，8点到18点，进入山区触发。
14❤：游戏总天数29天以上，收到信件，20点到24点，进入温泉触发。

PS:
这个mod应该和几乎所有mod兼容，高清肖像在Portraits文件夹中，需要下载999作为前置使用。有任何问题可以在这或者xhs找我，我看到有空就会修，但请尽量描述得详细一点，因为我比较菜。
___________________________________________________________________
（Sorry, my English is not good, so I used software translation）
Hello, this is the unofficial 1.6 update from Carnelian, which has been authorized by the original author.

The demon, who had been living in a harsh environment, failed in his struggle in the demon world and fled to the forest of Stardew Valley. With nowhere to go,
he decided to temporarily reside in this unknown and beautiful place.
If the new farmer is willing to approach him, perhaps he will permanently reside there?

Residence: The forest beneath Marnie's farm.
Favorite: Colorful Fragments Ruby Fairy Jewelry Bone Flute Apple Poppy Seed Muffin Void essence
Likes: Bat wings, food, flowers, rings, gemstones, minerals
Not liked: animal products fertilizers
Disgusting: Garbage Fish Feed Resources Eggplant

Event trigger:
0 ❤： After 7 days of gameplay, from 6:00 to 14:00, enter the forest to trigger.
two ❤： Sunny day, [already pet], from 6pm to 4pm, entering the forest triggers.
four ❤： Sunny day, from 20:00 to 23:00, triggering upon entering the beach.
six ❤： Sunny day, from 8am to 6pm, entering the secret forest triggers.
eight ❤： Sunny day, from 8am to 6pm, triggering upon entering the small town.
ten ❤： Sunny day, from 8am to 6pm, triggered when entering the mountainous area.
fourteen ❤： The total number of game days is 29 days or more. If you receive a letter, enter the hot spring trigger from 20:00 to 24:00.

PS:

This mod should be compatible with almost all mods, with high-definition portraits in the Portraits folder that require downloading 999 as a prerequisite. If you have any questions, please feel free to contact me here or XHS. I will fix them when I have time, but please try to describe them in more detail as I am a bit inexperienced.

！！ Anyone who wants to translate this mod into other languages is welcome, and I would be extremely grateful.！！
